description: Fetch neighborhood metadata (name, description, mayor_id, election_cycle, lot/avatar counts, activity rating, top lots/avatars). Read-only. Wire: DataServiceWrapperPDU carrying cTSONetMessageStandard GET on MaskedStruct.ServerNeighborhood (4236962517) with Parameter=neighborhood_id. The server streams a series of DataServiceWrapperPDU packets, each a cTSOTopicUpdateMessage delta filling a Neighborhood struct field; packets correlate back via SendingAvatarID. We collect deltas for a bounded window (2s) and return the observed fields projected by name plus the raw dotpath updates (for fields the projector doesn't know — arrays, nested election cycles). Default neighborhood_id=1. Cross-check source: fso_neighborhoods row.
call_signatures: cf $CF view-neighborhood                                                                                          # defaults neighborhood_id=1; 2s collection window
common_mistakes: 2-second collection window is baked in; response may be truncated if server hasn't finished streaming.
update_count=0 is possible for empty nhood or misconfigured provider id — check raw_dotpath_updates before trusting projected fields.
perception_hints: Neighborhood id (defaults to 1 on workshop): perception.lot.lot_id is a lot id, not a nhood id — most ops default nhood_id to 1
Your own persist_id (to avoid self-vote/self-nominate): perception.avatar.persist_id
Your lot membership (residency gate): perception.lot.owner_is_me or check is_roommate via query-lot
